retrievalProfile.description: A stark, minimalist landscape featuring heavy black ink branches that transition into thin, geometric lines against a desaturated, parchment-like background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition where thick, organic tree trunks on the left and right margins support a canopy of heavy black branches that fracture into a dense web of thin, straight geometric lines intersecting the upper sky. The background features a faint, sketch-like architectural outline on a warm, desaturated beige field.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic foreground trunks framing a central architectural sketch
Heavy horizontal branch weight contrasting with vertical linear sky
High-contrast black ink against a muted, neutral background
Symmetry between left and right framing elements
coreInvariants: The transition from thick, textured ink strokes to thin, perfectly straight geometric lines in the upper half.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large tree trunks frame the left and right edges, with a central horizontal branch structure spanning the middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, dark horizontal branch line that bisects the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the solid trunks upward through the thick branches and then follow the radiating thin lines into the upper corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of flat, desaturated beige space in the upper sky and lower ground to emphasize the line work.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for primary branch structures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between the black ink and the light background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to three main tones: beige, black, and one muted accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight geometric sans-serif used for all text elements to maintain minimalist balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean uppercase aesthetic.
Provides a similar weight and clarity for corner placement.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist ink drawing of two tree trunks framing a central house sketch on beige paper, with thick black branches that turn into a web of thin straight lines in the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners in a muted blue-purple color.

verificationChecks: Text is pinned to the top corners
Branches transition from thick ink to thin geometric lines

adjustableVariables: Density of the geometric line web
Thickness of the framing tree trunks
Specific hue of the corner typography
mustRedesign: Do not use gradients in the background
Ensure lines in the upper half are perfectly straight

mustAchieve: Stark contrast between black ink and beige background
Balanced framing of the central subject

postGenerationChecks: Are the upper lines straight and geometric?
Is the text in the top corners only?
Is the color palette restricted to beige, black, and one accent?
Does the composition feel balanced but stark?
recipe.reuseFormula: Stark ink landscape + geometric line sky + corner-pinned sans-serif typography.
